ranks: 6672-6745 (the next 60 untriaged by EDHREC rank), and effect:attach-extensions' attach-to-the-trigger-object, attach-to-the-source and attach-every-match cards

blocked.name: Deathmist Raptor
blocked.why: Megamorph (cast face down, turn face up for a cost with a +1/+1 counter), a 'whenever a permanent you control is turned face up' trigger, and returning 'face up or face down' are all unmodeled.

blocked.name: Imposing Grandeur
blocked.why: greatestCommanderManaValue counts a player's commanders in every zone (hand, graveyard, exile, library, stack); the card counts only commanders they own on the battlefield or in the command zone.

blocked.name: Dawn-Blessed Pennant
blocked.why: chooseCreatureTypeOnEnter offers every creature type; the card's choice is limited to Elemental, Elf, Faerie, Giant, Goblin, Kithkin, Merfolk or Treefolk (ofChosenType would otherwise cover the trigger and the graveyard target).

blocked.name: Phyrexian Unlife
blocked.why: No static for 'you don't lose the game for having 0 or less life' (narrower than Platinum Angel's can't-lose: poison and an empty library still kill), nor for damage dealt to you as though its source had infect while at 0 or less life.

blocked.name: Historian's Boon
blocked.why: 'Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control triggers' — the engine has chapter-resolves (finalOnly) only; a trigger on the chapter triggering goes on the stack beside it and fires even if that chapter ability is later countered or loses its targets.

blocked.name: Aethersquall Ancient
blocked.why: return-to-hand-all has no exceptSource and CardFilter can't exclude the source, so 'return all other creatures' would bounce the Ancient itself.

blocked.name: Curse of Fool's Wisdom
blocked.why: Madness isn't modeled (the Curse and its enchanted-player draw trigger are otherwise expressible).

blocked.name: Spirit Loop
blocked.why: deals-damage fires once per recipient; 'whenever enchanted creature deals damage' triggers once per simultaneous damage event (Angel of Deliverance / Vessel of the All-Consuming rulings), so a trample split or a double block would trigger twice (Armadillo Cloak's record).

blocked.name: Mythos of Snapdax
blocked.why: No 'each player chooses an artifact, a creature, an enchantment and a planeswalker, then sacrifices the rest' effect (a multi-typed permanent filling several slots), nor the {B}{R}-spent variant where the caster chooses for every player.

blocked.name: Roaring Furnace // Steaming Sauna
blocked.why: Steaming Sauna's ruling: unlocked after a 'your maximum hand size is N' permanent entered, its 'no maximum hand size' wins (the door's static takes the unlock's timestamp); the engine keeps the Room's entry timestamp (unlockDoor: 'same object, same timestamp'), so The Ten Rings / Twenty-Toed Toad / Cecily would wrongly win.

blocked.name: _____ Goblin
blocked.why: Name stickers (Unfinity, rule 123) aren't modeled: no sticker sheets, no 'put a name sticker on it', no vowels-on-the-sticker count.

blocked.name: The Stasis Coffin
blocked.why: 'You gain protection from everything until your next turn': there's no player protection (only player hexproof), so no prevention of all damage to the player and no aura/target bar.

blocked.name: Overgrown Zealot
blocked.why: 'Spend this mana only to turn permanents face up': ManaSpendOnly has no such restriction, and turning a face-down permanent face up (whyCannotTurnFaceUp/payMana) pays without a spend context the restriction could admit.

blocked.name: Stranglehold
blocked.why: No static stopping opponents from searching libraries (with the ruling's 'search … then shuffle' still shuffling, a 'you may search' not), and no replacement turning an opponent's extra turn into a skipped one.

blocked.name: Aragorn, Hornburg Hero
blocked.why: Renown N (rule 702.112) and the renowned designation aren't modeled, so neither 'attacking creatures you control have … renown 1' nor 'whenever a renowned creature you control deals combat damage' can be said.

blocked.name: Plasm Capture
blocked.why: delayed-trigger timing 'your-next-main-phase' fires at a postcombat main too (Mana Drain); 'your next first main phase' has no timing, so countered on your own precombat main it would pay out this turn instead of next

blocked.name: Tectonic Reformation
blocked.why: no static grants cycling {R} to land cards in your hand (only grantsToGraveyard / grantsToSpells exist)

blocked.name: Blitzball Stadium
blocked.why: support X needs up to X target slots with X the spell's value; and the granted 'draw a card for each kind of counter on it' has no amount counting counter kinds

blocked.name: Exponential Growth
blocked.why: 'double target creature's power X times' needs a repeat of the doubling X times (or an exponent amount); modify-pt's powerOf doubling happens once

blocked.name: Tainted Remedy
blocked.why: would-gain-life replacement has plus/multiplier/prevent but no 'loses that much life instead'; its ruling also has the gaining player order it against Rhox Faithmender-style doublers (rule 616.1), which the engine applies in a fixed order

blocked.name: Ironsoul Enforcer
blocked.why: the attacks-alone trigger takes only who (self / you-control / attached), no filter for 'this creature or a commander you control'; two triggers would fire twice when it is your commander

blocked.name: Case of the Stashed Skeleton
blocked.why: Cases (to solve / solved) aren't modeled (AUTHORING §15)

blocked.name: Anrakyr the Traveller
blocked.why: cast-now has only free casts, not 'pay life equal to its mana value rather than its mana cost', and its from is one zone, not 'from your hand or graveyard'

blocked.name: Espers to Magicite
blocked.why: The reflexive trigger's 'target creature card exiled this way' needs a target spec over exiled cards restricted to the creating resolution's exiles; no exile-zone target exists and `thisWay` matches nothing between resolutions.

blocked.name: Retribution of the Ancients
blocked.why: 'Remove X +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control' as a cost; removeCounter only removes a fixed count from the source.

blocked.name: Starscream, Power Hungry // Starscream, Seeker Leader
blocked.why: More Than Meets the Eye, convert and living metal are unmodeled, and there's no 'whenever you become the monarch' trigger.

blocked.name: Shakedown Heavy
blocked.why: 'Untap this creature and remove it from combat' has no remove-from-combat effect.

blocked.name: Hofri Ghostforge
blocked.why: The token's granted 'when this token leaves, return the exiled card to its owner's graveyard' must be linked to the one card exiled by that resolution (the rulings); exile `linked` ties a card to the source, not to a token.

blocked.name: Ty Lee, Chi Blocker
blocked.why: 'It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control Ty Lee' — only `doesntUntapNext` (one untap step) and a self-only `doesntUntap` static exist; no duration tied to continued control of the source.

blocked.name: Demonic Ruckus
blocked.why: Plot {R} (special action from hand, free cast from exile on a later turn) isn't built.
